thread:
mira: Quick sync — Borealis dedicated outage postmortem follow-up. Root cause summary: repeated VPC peering flaps + on‑prem firewall state issues + a routing replication race that left the tenant effectively isolated. I opened JIRA RED-857. Posting action items below; please ack + own what you can.

sandeep: I can own the peering hardening work. Plan: tighten keepalive timers, add BFD probe on the peering session, and enforce debounce logic so transient flaps don't trigger teardown. ETA: EOD Wed.

leo: I'll take the routing replication bug. Repro steps in the PM. Patch branch ready: `fix/routing-repl-atomic` — need a review and a canary deploy on the dedicated pool.

tanya: I'll coordinate on‑prem firewall runbook updates with the solutions and account teams. Need to schedule a customer maintenance window; tentative 3/27.

mira: Assigning owners so it's explicit — peering -> @sandeep, routing -> @leo, firewall/runbook -> @tanya. Also: add recurrence tracking (weekly checks) to avoid regressions.

jules: I'll add monitoring/alerting: new metric `peering_bgp_flap_count` + alert if >3 in 1h, and a dashboard panel showing flap spikes and correlated traces. Will link back to the postmortem.

ops-bot: Incident channel created: #incident-borealis-1719823456. Pager duty runbook attached to JIRA RED-857.

leo: Quick implementation detail — routing fix requires a small DB migration to add an `applied_at` guard column. Migration script is in branch; rolling restart will be needed.

sandeep: For peering tests, plan is: stage in dedicated-replica, run the flapper tool for 10m, validate failover metrics and BFD behavior, then promote to canary. I'll post logs and test results here.

marta: Oncall here — I'll own rollout windows and canaries. Proposed: canary Thu 02:00–04:00 UTC, full rollout Fri 01:00–05:00 UTC. ping @sandeep @leo for confirmation.

tanya: Customer comms drafted, waiting on final windows from @marta. Will send to account team once windows confirmed.

mira: Timeline recap: owners acked. Deliverables: sandeep (peering hardening PR + test plan), leo (routing patch + migration + canary), jules (alerting + dashboard), tanya (runbook + customer comms). Target: next Fri COB. If anyone needs extra time, flag now here.

leo: ack. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/3198

sandeep: ack. Test plan uploaded to RED-857.

jules: ack. Dashboards created — https://grafana.redwood.company/d/peering-borealis

marta: I'll create follow-up recurring check-ins — weekly for 4 weeks post-rollout to look for patterns and ensure flaps don't return.

mira: Small ops follow-up: add an "isolation_proof" checklist to the postmortem so SREs can quickly capture packet captures + traceroutes during an incident. Sample commands: `sudo tcpdump -i eth0 host <customer-ip> and port 179` and `sudo tcptraceroute <customer-ip>`.

tanya: Noted; adding the checklist to the runbook.

mira: Closing note — we'll review progress at the next incident retro on Mon 2026-03-29. Please update RED-857 with PRs, test outcomes, and customer windows as you complete them. :thumbsup:
